_citation.title: Photograph of banner at demonstration against the Italo-Abyssinian war in London

title: Photograph of banner at demonstration against the Italo-Abyssinian war in London
description: Black and White photograph of a banner in a crowd at a march against the Italo-Abyssinian war. The banner reads “Greetings to the heroic fight for Abyssinian independence. We pledge our friendship and support against fascist aggression.” The caption on the reverse reads “London Supports Abysinnia: Outside the Abyssinian Legation on Saturday, when nearly 2000 Londoners presented an address promising the support and sympathy of the English people to Abyssinia her war of independence. Amongst those who signed the address were the names of Sylvia Pankhurst, Harry Pollitt and Lascelles Abercrombie.”
